description: Get a link a workspace owner or admin opens to connect an Amazon seller account (platform "amazon", optional region na/eu/fe), a Shopify shop (platform "shopify", shop "your-store.myshopify.com") or a WooCommerce store (platform "woocommerce", shop "https://your-store.com"). Optionally appId ties the store to one product. The owner approves at the store; nothing is connected until they do, and no credential passes through this tool. A PrestaShop store is connected in the dashboard's Settings with a key, never through chat. Nooticr writes only listing copy and prices; it also reads orders and stock on Shopify, and sales, traffic, account health and FBA stock on Amazon. Each call mints a fresh link. No cost to call. Use when the user wants to connect their Amazon, Shopify or WooCommerce store.

appId.description: Product id to tie the store to.

platform.description: Which store platform to connect. PrestaShop is connected in Settings, never here.

shop.description: Shopify shop domain (your-store.myshopify.com), or the WooCommerce store's https address.

name: connect_store

connectUrl.description: Open this in a browser to approve the connection.
